token_family_docs.$description: Elevation mode collection — surface level. Modes: level_0 (the base — no class is applied), level_1 (.ob-elevation-level-1), level_2 (.ob-elevation-level-2). Each mode carries the CSS class string the application adds to a container to activate it. The mode picks the background of a surface and the Button backgrounds that depend on it.

selector.$description: level_0 is the base elevation mode — no class is applied. It is the first-paint default.
level_1 is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
level_2 is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
